+

+class _RuntimeSession:

+        self.login_id = login_id

+        self.closed = False

+    def account_read(self) -> dict[str, Any]:

+        return {}

+        self.calls.append(("account/logout", None))
+        return {}

pull_request.body:
## Summary
Replace StaffDeck-managed ChatGPT subscription OAuth and private HTTP calls with the local Codex app-server runtime.

## Changes
- Use runtime-owned account status, login, logout, completion, and streaming.
- Keep the official OpenAI Python SDK on Platform API-key model branches.
- Remove subscription credential persistence and direct OAuth callbacks.
- Document the configured local Codex CLI and update the model configuration UI.

## Testing
- 109 focused backend tests passed.
- Targeted Ruff check passed.
- ModelsPage unit tests, i18n/config checks, and production build passed.
- Read-only smoke verified app-server initialization and safe account-status mapping using the installed local Codex CLI.

## Risks
- A real model generation was not automated to avoid consuming a ChatGPT subscription; deployment requires a local signed-in Codex CLI.
